methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one assumption ID (native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery), one quantified implication and exact dependency closure. Check current handoffs, including #5625 row reentry and #5707 root-prefix lowering, without treating their partial scope as the whole theorem. actual_scope: Prove the unchanged physical Gaussian production matrix has row gap > u^2/(2(p+u^2)) and inverse infinity norm < 2+2p/u^2, conditional on cited predecessor estimates.

stop_rule: Ship the first proved conditioning improvement. Do not extend to a production page, infinite-tail theorem or multiplier.
